message.content: Based on the timeline provided in the interactions, it appears that the process took less than 3 weeks. Initially, LiHua inquired about adding an air-conditioner to the basement (interaction 3). Adam Smith confirmed that he would check with the maintenance team and get back to her (interaction 3). He then informed LiHua that the contractor team was coming to install the air-conditioner in the basement at 6 PM the following day (interaction 4). This indicates that the installation occurred within a single day of LiHua's inquiry, suggesting the entire process from initial request to installation was completed within 3 days. Therefore, it did not take more than 3 weeks for the air-conditioner to be installed.
